title: Ray Dalio Is Warning About an AI Bubble. Here's What I'm Doing
creator: Couch Investor
summary: Couch Investor rebuts Ray Dalio's fresh AI-bubble/debt-crisis warning by auditing Dalio's prediction track record (1980s depression call, 2015/17 1937-style crash calls, repeated 3-year debt-crisis warnings — all missed; only 2008 correct). He concedes Dalio's valid points (yields rising — 10y at 5.3%, heavy AI capex, widening credit spreads) but counters with data: combined GOOGL/MSFT/AMZN/META free cash flow dips to -$37.7B in FY27 then rebounds to +$88B in FY28, capex is funded from operating cash flow not debt, and combined ROIC (~24% at the trough vs ~8% cost of capital) justifies the spend. Trust the tech leadership over the broken clock. No explicit stock calls — a macro/thesis video defending AI-capex names (Amazon, Alphabet, Microsoft, Meta, Nvidia, Micron, Oracle).
